I'm back doing some [#TidyTuesday](https://www.tidytuesday.com/) visualizations. This week let's get bird-brained. [The dataset](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/main/data/2026/2026-04-14/readme.md) has 2 objects (I have already joined the wind and sea data to the ships data):

- `birds` Observation data related to bird sightings. Includes things like bird count, plumage of birds, behavior of birds.
- `ships` Observation data related to the location of the ship, date and time of observation, weather conditions, and sea conditions.


::: {.cell}

:::


## Snapshot of birds data
